summarization:
This smartphone UI screen is designed for selecting a prank chat theme. It features six hexagonal icons, each representing a different messaging or calling application. The icons are:

1. WhatsApp (green icon)
2. Viber (purple icon)
3. Skype (blue icon)
4. Facebook Messenger (blue icon with a white lightning bolt)
5. SMS (orange icon)
6. An additional option (red icon with a plus sign)

At the top, there is a header that reads "Choose prank chat theme." At the bottom, there is an advertisement banner with various product images and a prompt to install an app from the Google Play Store.
